Little Big Town's "Boondocks" reached #46 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Boondocks" is a song co-written and recorded by American country music group Little Big Town.

It was released in May 2005 as the first single from their second studio album The Road to Here.

The song peaked at #46 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.
